title: Skill Trigger-Routing Evidence Artifact (FR-005)
description: Schema for one committed conformance/skills/trigger-evidence/<run-timestamp>.json file. Derived from muster@v1.2.1's SkillsCaseResult/AxisVerdict shapes (data-model.md) plus this mission's own derived runsErrored-per-case sum (research.md §2), which does not exist as a field in muster's own JSON output.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the workflow run that produced this artifact.

model.description: The model that actually produced this run (manifest default or MUSTER_MODEL override) -- never a hardcoded/assumed value.

endpointHost.description: Bare host only (new URL(MUSTER_ENDPOINT).host). Must never contain '@' (credential-in-URL guard, NFR-002) or a full URL/path/query string.

runsErrored.description: Derived: sum(shouldTriggerAxis.queryBreakdown[].runsErrored) + sum(nearMissAxis.queryBreakdown[].runsErrored) from muster's raw --json output for this case. Never omitted, even when 0 -- NFR-003 requires a runsErrored:0/triggerRate:0 case to be visually distinguishable from a runsErrored>0/triggerRate:0 case, which is only possible if the field is always present.
